inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver did not have doucmentation of 30 hours completed for the 2025-2026 training year. Only 20.5 hours of training was available
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Refrigerate Separate from Food: Serveral bottles of medication was observed to be stored next to food    NOTE: Corrected at inspection, the medication was removed and stored spearately
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Refrigerate Separate from Food (26 TAC §747.3607(3))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: A child was observed to be sleeping on the couch during the inspection.     NOTe: Corrected at inspection, a mat for the child was pulled during the inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §747.4303(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation - Cover All Stored Food: Open/cut vegetables was observed to be uncovered in the refrigerator.      NOTE: Corrected at inspection, the vegetables were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation - Cover All Stored Food (26 TAC §747.3117(7))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area: The primary caregiver has been usuing baby wipes to sanitize the diaper changing table    NOTE: Corrected at inspection, the primary caregiver made a water/bleach soultion to use as sanitizer for the diaper changing table
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area (26 TAC §747.3307(d))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Handwashing After Diapering a Child: The caregiver was observed changing a diaper. The caregiver was using gloves, After removing the gloves the caregiver did not wash hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §747.3211(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A childs hands were not observed to be washed following a diaper change
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §747.3213(3))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary caregiver and assistant caregiver did not have current training in pediatric cpr/first aid. Training expired 2/5/2024
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The outer fence was observed to be in need of repair. Broken board and a leaning wall was observed to be creating a harzard for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §747.4407(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training: One caregiver left in charge of a group of 5 children 16mo-3yrs old did not have training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area: The diaper changing table was not observed to be sanitized after a child's diaper was changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area (26 TAC §747.3307(d))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: A child was allowed to eat a piece of a banana while the caregiver placed the child on a diaper changing table for a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §747.3303(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation - Cover All Stored Food: Multiple items of food were observed to be in the refrigerator open and ovcoverd. This included strawberries, broken cooked and raw eggs, an avacado, a pot of food, and yogurt.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation - Cover All Stored Food (26 TAC §747.3117(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Records for 8 children was reviewed. All 8 children were missing an address for the emergency contact listed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for  Caregivers -  15 hours Annual Training: For the 2021-2022 training period, the assistant caregiver present only had 3 hours of training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for  Caregivers -  15 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: For the 2021-2022 training period the primary caregiver only had 23 hours of training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An assistant caregiver was observed to be present without notification of eligibility from the background check unit. The
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Assistant Caregivers and Substitutes Comply with Minimum Standard Rules: The assistant caregiver did not have  documentation the following    24 hours of preservice training,  Required training for care of children under 24 months  Notarized affidavit  Orientation training  Documentation of high school diploma or GED
occurrences.violation_type_title: Assistant Caregivers and Substitutes Comply with Minimum Standard Rules (26 TAC §747.207(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An assistant caregiver was observed to be present without notification of eligibility from the background check unit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The assistant caregiver does not have training in pediatric first aid and CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Two children 10 and 14 mo were allowed to watch television while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation - Use Sanitary Holders: An infant was observed to be placed in an exosauser and given a snack. The snack was placed in the childs had and was not given a napkin or other sanitary holder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §747.3117(5))

occurrences.finding: Length of Naptime: Two children who arrived at 6am were allowed to nap for more that 3 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Length of Naptime (26 TAC §747.2803)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Children in care were observed with screen time activites while eating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: A 3yr old child was observed to be sleeping on a folded blanket on the floor. According to the primary caregiver, they only have 4 nap mats available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §747.4303(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home: The primary caregiver was observed to be over ratio. There were 12 children between the ages of 11mo and 10 yrs old. The primary caregiver was over ratio by 2 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: Children in care were allowed to use screen time devices for more than the one hour.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Children in care were observed watching tv and one child was observed watching videos on Youtube. The screen time was not associated with an activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(1))
